episodes.title: Russell Brand’s Prison Reality (Prison Coach Explains)
episodes.description:
Russell Brand will meet people in prison who know his name, recognize his face, and may want something from him. How should he respond?

In this interview, I discuss HMP Wandsworth, what people in our community have told me about serving time there, and the problems celebrity and money can create inside prison.

We talk about confinement, contraband, prison friendships, work assignments, and what I would tell Brand if his lawyers called me. I also explain why trying to buy comfort or friendship can bring consequences someone new to prison may not anticipate.

I served 388 days in federal prison. Since coming home in 2009, I’ve helped people and their families prepare for sentencing, prison, and release through White Collar Advice.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Russell Brand and life at Wandsworth
00:48 Overcrowding, vermin, and contraband
01:41 What I would tell Brand and his lawyers
02:43 How to respond when another prisoner confronts you
03:43 Could he move between prisons?
05:37 What do you do in a cell for 22 hours?
06:35 From celebrity life to confinement
07:57 Prison jobs, routines, and teaching
09:37 Buying friendship, favors, or protection
10:50 Why prison conditions remain so poor
12:43 Overcrowding and preparing people to come home
